summary: Show hash-bound USDB block economics after node replay verification
details: Add Block economics to USDB navigation and link from block details and network overview; show the historical Miner Pass, emission, issued counter and per-transaction miner/Dividend fees with exact decimal precision.

Only expose verified v1 reports through a bounded GET endpoint, validate block identity and accounting totals, and recheck canonical hash before returning results. Keep the expensive node RPC outside the public JSON-RPC allowlist.

Distinguish genesis, empty blocks, old nodes, missing archive state, unsupported policies, verification failure, reorgs and replay limits without returning unverified amounts or private upstream diagnostics.
Update the preview notice without opening unqualified Blockscout reward/burn/supply fields. Per-block replay does not qualify circulating supply, all history or realtime push.
operator_actions: Upgrade the private read node to a release providing eth_getUSDBBlockEconomics and retain parent archive state and historical Miner Pass data. Old nodes keep ordinary Explorer functions but cannot serve the new report.
After installing the Explorer release, run down, prepare --replace, preflight and up, then verify representative blocks in Block economics. Preserve existing credentials and database volumes.
